name: Planar Instability (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Elemental or outsider

Benefit(s): You scramble the planar connections in your immediate area. Any creature attempting to use a conjuration (summoning) or conjuration (teleportation) spell within a radius of 10-feet per Hit Die of you, must make a successful caster level check equal to 11 plus your Hit Dice or the spell is countered.
